value.answer: No men's Euros are on right now. The last one was Euro 2024, and the next is Euro 2028 in June-July 2028. Which one do you mean? If you're in Canada, the Euro 2028 qualifiers are on DAZN in English according to Live Soccer TV, and TVA Sports has the 2028 tournament rights, though that comes from older reports. A basketball Euro listing also shows DAZN, but I can't tell if it's current. Check the broadcaster before you plan around any of it.
